items.title: Data Sources and Data Collection Methods (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Data Sources and Data Collection Methods' under topic 6.2 (PDF 78, printed 74).

blocks.text: Data bohat se sources (zaraye) se jama kiya ja sakta hai. Aam sources: surveys, interviews, forms, sensors aur online platforms (jaise blogs, social websites waghaira). Manual (haath se) data collection mein insani mehnat lagti hai, jab ke automatic (khud-kaar) data collection mein machines aur software kaam karte hain. Data real time (usi waqt, foran) bhi jama ho sakta hai aur waqt ke saath store karke bhi. Kaun sa tareeqa ho, yeh analysis ke maqsad par munhasir hai. Achhe sources aur durust collection se analysis ki quality behtar hoti hai.
